payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (commits dd7ca8d store+cli). All four: frick backup / frick restore (NDJSON dump/restore on the FrickStore facade, 5 refusals, clock-free; CLI wired), frick verify (native frick-codegen drift check, exit 1 on divergence — replaces pnpm verify:generated), and frick inspect diagnostics (DiagnosticsSnapshot v1 + GET /_frick/inspect/diagnostics). All four smoke-tested end to end. Known sub-gaps documented: idempotency-cache stats + recentErrors in diagnostics are defaults pending FrickStore facade getters (FR-249); Postgres dump dialect is the FR-242 follow-up (SQLite path shipped).
